title: CReal.ivt_exact_root_at: the exact-root theorem generalized to an arbitrary target value
statement: CReal.ivt_exact_root_at generalizes CReal.ivt_exact_root from a root of F (Equiv (F c) zero) to a preimage of an arbitrary target y with F a <= y <= F b: there exists c in [a, b] with Equiv (F c) y. It carries the SAME strong hypothesis as ivt_exact_root -- a uniformly positive derivative on all of [a, b] -- because it is built as a direct wrapper: shift F by the constant y to get G := fun z => add (F z) (neg y), whose root is F's y-preimage, and re-run ivt_exact_root on G. No weaker hypothesis is available here than for the y = 0 case; this fact does not relax ivt_exact_root's boundary, it only removes its restriction to a single fixed target.

formal.statement: theorem CReal.ivt_exact_root_at : ((x0 : ((x0 : CReal) -> CReal)) -> ((x1 : ((x1 : CReal) -> CReal)) -> ((x2 : CReal) -> ((x3 : CReal) -> ((x4 : CReal.HasDerivativeOn x0 x1 x2 x3) -> ((x5 : CReal.UniformlyContinuousOn x0 x2 x3) -> ((x6 : CReal.le x2 x3) -> ((x7 : CReal) -> ((x8 : CReal.le (x0 x2) x7) -> ((x9 : CReal.le x7 (x0 x3)) -> ((x10 : AxNat) -> ((x11 : ((x11 : CReal) -> ((x12 : CReal.le x2 x11) -> ((x13 : CReal.le x11 x3) -> CReal.le (CReal.ofRat (Rat.natDivSucc (AxNat.succ AxNat.zero) x10)) (x1 x11))))) -> Exists.{1} CReal (fun (x12 : CReal) => And (CReal.le x2 x12) (And (CReal.le x12 x3) (CReal.Equiv (x0 x12) x7)))))))))))))))

notes: Not a re-derivation of CReal.ivt_exact_root -- a wrapper. G's derivative and continuity come from CReal.has_derivative_sub/CReal.uniformly_continuous_sub composed with the constant-function versions at y (a constant shift changes neither); the derivative-bound hypothesis transports through the ring identity F' z ~ F' z - 0; G a <= 0 <= G b is CReal.add_le_add/CReal.add_neg applied to F a <= y <= F b; and ivt_exact_root's Equiv (G c) zero reads back as Equiv (F c) y via monotone.rs's equiv_of_sub_equiv_zero. See the CReal.ivt_exact_root_at field doc in creal.rs. Source: crates/axeyum-lean-kernel/src/creal/inverse_fn.rs.
